reviewNotes: Historical English-fork display/compatibility/sample reviews are retained; c28900e reviews multilingual display boundaries and Windows capabilities, and the 1d5a774 follow-up separately reviews durable ledger recovery and broker-acknowledged protection. These approvals are not a language-only behavior-equivalence claim.

Trading/account/storage identities remain stable. New shipped samples use English code identifiers; existing user code is not renamed automatically. The explicitly authorized local five-file migration had backups, no saved references, token-equivalence checks and identical default/custom-parameter replays. Existing regression tests still cover legacy ledger/parameter/template recovery.
Template raw C# is fingerprinted recursively, ignoring only comments and string text, so indicator/strategy math is not hidden by the raw-string envelope.
This file is a reviewed allowlist, not a request to suppress future failures. Investigate and review every new exception or structural hash.
Final visual review: live-launch dropdown refreshes compiled display metadata; the data-page action row sits below the full-width title to avoid narrow-window clipping.

Reviewed sample-only identifier renames in StrategyCatalog, UserScripts and CodeEditorWindow: class/file/parameter/private/local names are English; numeric expressions and control flow are unchanged after the explicit old-to-new identifier map. No trading-engine or provider protocol change. The actual New indicator template has a red/green regression check.

The baseline remains 9ee74a4c527ac43120423acd41e006ec9d7877ad, not the rolling upstream checkpoint. Every approvedStructure path has an individual reviewedFiles reason; added C# files require their own exact structural fingerprint rather than folder approval.

Canonical C# and new-code templates remain English. Only exact locale/native-language labels and documented protocol/persistence/data constants are literal exceptions. Runtime es/zh-CN JSON catalogs and retained non-English documentation are not source-code exemptions; English UI/documentation/code-example gates remain in place.

Numeric tokens, identifiers, control flow and recursively parsed strategy/indicator raw-template code remain fingerprinted by the existing Roslyn algorithm; no source-structure, added-file or Spanish-candidate gate is disabled. This inventory records source review only; builds, regressions, isolated multilingual UI and native Windows runtime/restart evidence belong to separate release gates.

The reviewed ledger now uses generation-bound checksummed append intents, disk flushes, bounded fresh-process replay and an interprocess lease. This is process-crash consistency, not power-loss durability, broker-event exactly-once delivery or authoritative execution accounting. Local reducing markers and sibling coordination remain distinct from exchange-native OCO/reduce-only; unknown submission attribution remains session-local.

Non-KVP adoption records exact per-path fingerprints from the latest compiled UiSnapshot Structure consumer after both independent source-review axes cleared, including ChartRenderer/ChartView responsive full-warning and extreme compact disclosure. Parent observed the combined Release build with zero warnings/errors. Latest actual warning/fidelity/multilingual visuals, full English/deletion/catalog gates and full suite remain separate pending acceptance; no language-only equivalence, installed-app, native-provider, paid-model or power-loss certification is implied. Historical broker/ledger notes and baseline9ee74a4 remain intact; only the obsolete IbProbe receives an original-baseline-hash-bound deletion review.
